brief:
Resistance security forces in Gaza said they have documented evidence that Israeli intelligence is inciting the use of weapons during family disputes, according to Shehab Wire. The "Al-Harissa" platform, operated by the security apparatus, released the information as part of what it characterized as a broader Israeli campaign to provoke internal conflict among Palestinians.

The security forces announced they would take strict measures against those involved in such incidents. Officials did not specify what actions would be taken or provide details of the documented cases they claimed to have on file. The accusation reflects mounting concerns within Gaza about armed clashes between families amid the broader conflict with Israel.
